desc: Derive the prefix-set reduction: at time t, smoke exists at (R,C) iff P_t - (R,C) appeared among P_0,...,P_{t-1}.

Implement the Python solution: read N, R, C and S; maintain the current prefix position starting at (0,0) and a seen set initialized with {(0,0)}; for each character in S, update the prefix by its direction delta, check whether (current_r - R, current_c - C) is in seen and append '1' or '0', then insert the current prefix into seen; finally print the concatenated answer string.
Verify edge cases and performance: initial prefix included, query before insertion, negative coordinates, N=1, and O(N) runtime/memory.
